title: LOVE IT!
text: LOVE IT!. Really awesome, got this on prime day and it was a great buy! I honestly had a hard time opening it first because I just assumed it was like pull out type of cover but it's just twist and open which is honestly so muchhh easier to use and great, I like how it's still very tight despite that and also it's not too heavy like other types of these mugs and containers. It's also super easy to clean as well and to hold, I like it a lot honestly I might buy another one as well.

product_metadata.title: Ello Lil' Campy Vacuum
features: Perfect for the Commute: 11 oz vacuum insulated stainless steel travel mug designed to keep drinks cold up to 10 hours and hot for 5 hours. Enjoy this stainless steel mug that is car cup friendly and completely leak-proof.
Comfy Carry Handle: Convenient handle with Ello Evercork inlay is designed for taking coffee on-the-go.
Guarateed Leak-Proof: Ello's patented sealing slider won't leak and is designed for easy, one-handed open/close.
Easy Cleaning: To ensure product quality and longevity, hand wash the mug. The lid is dishwasher safe.
